$description: The media library: every image and video the site and brand outputs use, one slot each. Supplied files are fetched and pinned in media.lock.json (make media-fetch); awaited files are added by D-SAP at the slot's path, then pinned the same way; encoded files are made from a supplied original by make media-encode (packages/media/encode.json), then pinned; generated files come from make brand. Components ask for a slot id, never a path. Internet placeholders are allowed only where placeholderAllowed is true, with a licence that allows commercial use (plan Part 0.2). make media writes the list of files still to add to docs/setup/media-to-add.md.

scrub.$description: Every image is rewritten before it is pinned, without EXIF, XMP, IPTC, comments, thumbnails, timestamps or anything after the picture (phone photos carry where and when they were taken). keepColourProfile keeps the colour profile only, because dropping it can change how colours look. Videos are made clean by make media-encode and checked here.
